title.zh: 宣布每年 8 月 1 日为萨马省特别非工作假日（名称为萨马日）的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring August 1 of Every Year A Special Nonworking Holiday in the Province of Samar To Be Known As “Samar Day”, in Commemoration of Its Foundation Day

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2024/ra_12038_2024.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: August 11 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in the Province of Samar to be known as "Samar Day", in commemoration if its Foundation Day.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
